title: Fix the playoffs docs that say the season is not in the address
request: Fix the older playoffs doc lines that say the season is not in the address. The page itself puts ?season=<id> in the address, keeps it on reload, and the picker sets it.

criteria.text: E1 The page doc no longer says the season is missing from the address: the What survives lines, While editing, After any interrupt, Season scoping, URL state and the footer say it is there, and the open question about a season lost on reload is removed because it no longer happens.

E2 Checklist rows PLAYOFF-11, PLAYOFF-13 and PLAYOFF-28 say what the page does (shown in a real browser with fake data). PLAYOFF-28 loses the suspected-bug mark, and the verification README count goes from 117 to 116 (recount by the README method: 1,958 items, 116 P1 suspected-bug rows).

E3 Every new sentence is true: read against usePlayoffPageData.ts and shown in a real browser (a bracket link gets its season; a bare /playoffs gets ?season=; picking a season changes the address, adds a step, closes the bracket and survives a reload; a bracket in a non-automatic season survives a reload with its season).
E4 Docs only: no code, test, config or lock file changed. All required repo checks pass on the final commit and a fresh independent reviewer approves.
E5 No other doc in docs/ still says the old thing (search for the old phrases comes back empty).
